title: He built an AI company from scratch. Jeff Bezos backed it. Forbes now values him at $2.1 billion.
caption:
He built an AI company from scratch. Jeff Bezos backed it. Forbes now values him at $2.1 billion.

Born in Chennai, he holds a Bachelor's and Master's from IIT Madras and a PhD in Computer Science from UC Berkeley, with earlier research stints at OpenAI and Google DeepMind. He co-founded the AI search company Perplexity in August 2022.

Perplexity's valuation climbed from $520 million in January 2024 to $9 billion by December 2024, then $20 billion by late 2025 - backed by investors including Jeff Bezos, Yann LeCun and Google's chief scientist Jeff Dean. The company built its identity around citing sources directly in AI-generated answers, a deliberate bet against black-box search.

A Viksit Bharat by 2047 needs its own technical education to be recognized as world-class capital, not just a launchpad abroad. Srinivas's IIT Madras training is exactly what the world's biggest investors are now backing at scale.
